releases.name: v0.3.1 — push-to-talk dictation for OpenCode v2
releases.body:
Local-only push-to-talk dictation for OpenCode v2. Press F9, speak (pauses welcome), press F9 — your words land in an editable draft. No cloud, no temp audio files, no auto-send, no permission answering.

## Highlights

- **Toggle dictation**: F9 starts, F9 stops — thinking pauses never end the take (60 s cap, configurable)
- **Per-session drafts**: every chat keeps its own accumulated takes; switching chats never mixes or loses them
- **Edit before send**: the draft editor opens after every take — scroll through long drafts, fix mistakes, Ctrl+Enter sends everything as one prompt
- **Esc keeps your edits**: edits are folded back into the draft on every close path
- **Safety guards**: mid-take chat switch discards only that take; a failed send keeps the draft; wrong-session delivery is blocked
- **STT health dot** (`🟢`/`🔴`) + **`voice-check` recovery skill** (`@voice-check`)
- **Bundled recorders** for macOS (arm64/x64) and Linux (x64) — attached below; SHA256-pinned and verified in CI
- **Fast GPU transcription**: `servers/mlx_server.py` runs whisper on Apple Silicon (~2–3 s per take)

## Keys (Fn-prefixed on MacBooks)

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| F9 | dictate a take |
| F10 | open the session's draft editor |
| F12 | wipe the draft (confirm dialog) |

Slash commands `/dictate`, `/voice-send`, `/voice-clear`, `/voice-setup` work everywhere.

## Install

Requires a local STT server (see `docs/STT.md`) and mic permission for your terminal.

```sh
opencode plugin add @vaibhavgupta0786/opencode-voice
```

Restart the TUI, open a session, press F9. Troubleshooting: `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`.
